serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
From all this reading I got hungry. Gotta eat something really quick. 
Shit… I’m out of snacks…
There is always this social food dispenser with free rations outside, but bread from it tastes really bad. 
Maybe it’s called bread, but it’s more like some tasteless grey cube.
If I feel like it I will go buy some real food. I should probably wait until I have money and time for that.
Anyway, it’s time for my coffee. Lucky for me I bought a big number of capsules for my machine so I don’t need to worry about them for about a year. 
They were on sale, because the manufacturer went out of business. The reason was health and safety of users or something, I don’t remember anymore.
*ping*
Hell yeah! Now we’re talking.
I wonder, what am I going to do next?
